results.outcome: FIXED - fully abstract colored-node network diagram, zero readable text; laptop in background closed/no visible logo.

results.outcome: FIXED - no recognizable real hardware logo anywhere; whiteboard flowchart is fully abstract boxes/arrows, zero readable text (bonus - this ID was not one of the 8 text offenders but the text policy held here too).

results.outcome: FIXED - no recognizable real hardware logo; whiteboard is now a physical flowchart of icons/shapes/sticky-note cards, zero readable text (the previous dashboard-style touchscreen UI is also gone).
